unknown_rule: unknown/unresolved evidence -> explicit Frontier item; never guess merely to fill a field
proof_rule: retain source evidence plus independent mathematical/reasoning proof where applicable; do not promote model outputs to empirical state
change_rule: mutate living owner where supported; preserve stable IDs, source paths, evidence class, supersessions, receipts and readback
duplicate_rule: collapse identical meaning to one semantic owner while preserving source/representation lineage

anthropocentric_audit.purpose: explicitly test human-exceptionalist/anthropocentric assumptions where relevant to ecology, governance, technology and ethics; analytical lens only, never evidentiary override

publication_rule: public-ready != published; exact release target/lens/security filter/readback required
source_precedence: current scoped owner/native source > validated derivative > historical/legacy reference, subject to evidence class and explicit contradictions
view_rule: task/device/user preferences may select or compose views but cannot override security, evidence ceiling or semantic authority
